newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania police arrest Turks in biggest heroin haul.
newsitem.headline: Romania police arrest Turks in biggest heroin haul.

text.p: Police said on Tuesday they had seized 83 kg (182 pounds) of pure heroin, the biggest post-communist haul in Romania, and arrested three Turks and two Romanians.

Police spokesman Cornel Diaconu said the drugs, worth the equivalent of $4 million, were hidden in a car followed by officers after it left the garages of two Turkish coach companies that had been under police surveillance for some time.
The weekend haul was the second involving travel agencies which take tourists to Turkey. Last year police caught a Turkish driver with 42 kg (92 pounds) of pure heroin hidden aboard his coach.
If convicted, the five face up to 15 years in jail. Diaconu said life sentences could be imposed if the group was found to be part of a large-scale smuggling ring.
Romania has tightened its criminal code to halt an increase in smuggling through the country, a favourite transit point since Yugoslav routes were closed during the Bosnian war.

Since the 1989 fall of communism, police have seized over 19 tonnes of drugs in more than 230 cases. Officials say the country is also developing into a drug consumer market despite average monthly salaries of only $80.
